name: Sago Mini Trips+
summary: Sago Mini Trips+ brings together four fan-favorite preschool games into one kid-friendly app – Road Trip, Boats, Planes, and Trains. Travel to far-off destinations with your Sago Mini friends and discover lots of fun and surprises along the way. With no WiFi or internet required, it’s perfect for on-the-go playtime or your next big trip.
